title: Operator review/override UI for AI consensus output (separate from customer portal)
brief: CLAUDE.md mandate: 'Operator-in-the-loop is unconditional'. V1 buried this in MS15 (customer portal) but operator + customer are different surfaces. Operator UI surfaces AI consensus picks (machine, strategy, feed) with provenance, accept/reject/override, and writes rejections back to outcome ledger as labeled negatives for MS18 LoRA training.

phases.title: Operator review UI + override path + ledger integration

units.title: UI surface: render consensus output with provenance (web or desktop)
exit_conditions: operator sees: question, options[], per-voice answer, agreement %, recommended pick, latency, cost
click any pick to see voice-level provenance
units.description: Reuse mcp-server/web/ thin client. Add consensus-review page reading from prism_ai:consensus_audit_query.

units.title: Override path: accept/reject/replace with reason
exit_conditions: operator can accept (default), reject (with reason), replace (with own answer + reason)
units.description: Override path is the operator-in-the-loop closure.

units.title: Wire rejections to outcome ledger as labeled negatives for MS18
exit_conditions: each operator rejection writes 1 row to CrossProcessOutcomeStore with label=NEGATIVE + reason
MS18 LoRA training pipeline picks these up automatically
tests: 5 rejections in ledger -> next training run includes them
units.description: Closes the operator->learning loop. The system gets smarter from operator pushback.

acceptance: operator can review AI consensus output (machine/strategy/feed picks) with provenance, accept/reject/override; rejections auto-write to outcome ledger as labeled negatives for MS18 LoRA training; CLAUDE.md operator-in-the-loop mandate satisfied.

risks.description: Operators distrust AI and reject everything, polluting training data; mitigation = separate ACCEPT/REJECT/REPLACE labels with reason categories; weight by operator skill score
UI bug causes silent decision drops; mitigation = OperatorDecisionEvent must round-trip through outcome ledger before UI shows 'saved'
